LeansRUSH

Zarya leans rush, and can flex into dive comps when the team shape calls for it.

Zarya is a Tank hero in Overwatch. In 5V5, All Ranks, Zarya holds a 48.4% win rate across 51,223 community-tracked matches. Zarya's hardest counters are Symmetra, Brigitte, and Lifeweaver, while their strongest team-up partners are Vendetta, Torbjörn, and Zenyatta. Looking for who counters Zarya, or which heroes Zarya counters? This page ranks Zarya's hardest counters and easiest matchups, plus per-10-minute combat stats versus the Tank role average, strongest duos, and the best and worst maps. Data refreshes daily from community matches, last updated Oct 2, 2026.

Quick answers

Zarya counters, answered

Who counters Zarya in Overwatch?
Zarya's hardest counters in Overwatch are Symmetra, Brigitte, and Lifeweaver. They rank highest on Counterwatch's counter score against Zarya, built from one-on-one duels and teamfight outcomes in recent community matches rather than match win rate.
Who is Zarya strong against?
Zarya counters Genji, Winston, and Doomfist hardest, ranked by counter score in Zarya's favor from duel and teamfight data.
Who are the best heroes to play with Zarya?
Zarya's strongest team-ups are Vendetta, Torbjörn, and Zenyatta, ranked by how well they perform alongside Zarya in recent community matches.

How is this calculated?

Three lenses on the same data, all filtered to enemies whose counter rating against Zarya is positive. The rating comes from one-on-one duels and teamfight outcomes in community matches, not match win rate, and it strips each hero's general strength so only the matchup remains. The rating on the row is the same value shown on the hardest-matchups card, and matchups need 50+ contributing players before they appear at all.

  • Combined: pickrate multiplied by counter rating. The default. A moderate counter you'll face every other match ranks higher than a hard counter nobody plays.
  • Pickrate: Share of teams that play the hero. The game doesn't report bans, so matches where the hero was banned still count. Useful when you want to ban someone you'll definitely face.
  • Counter strength: the counter rating alone, ignoring frequency. Useful when you want to remove your worst matchup regardless of how often they're picked.

Per-map ban data isn't available yet. Matchups in our dataset aren't broken down by map.

The confidence dots on each row reflect how many players contributed duel data to that matchup. A niche hero with a thin player base lands lower on the dots even when their rating is high, so you can tell which bans are battle-tested and which are still forming.
